gates.label: Reliable measured production data
gates.requirement: The production channel is of the measured class, its metering is declared reliable enough, and the assessment window is sufficiently complete. Synthetic, modelled or unknown-origin production never passes outside a demonstration.

gates.label: Baseline of documented origin
gates.requirement: The expected energy comes from a baseline whose method and source are declared.

gates.label: Significant under-performance now
gates.requirement: In the assessment window the gap exceeds both the materiality threshold and the combined expanded uncertainty of baseline and metering.

gates.label: Credible measured soiling evidence
gates.requirement: A direct soiling measurement (soiling station, clean/dirty reference pair, or equivalent) of the measured class, recent enough, showing a loss above the credibility floor and above its own uncertainty. A production gap is not soiling evidence.

gates.label: Soiling measurement consistent with the production gap
gates.requirement: The measured soiling loss and the gap left after the other quantified factors agree within the tolerance.

gates.label: No unresolved technical issue
gates.requirement: No open outage, under-performing device, availability alert or unresolved fault record in the assessment window.

gates.label: No critical contradiction in the evidence
gates.requirement: No pair of sources contradict each other in a way that changes the conclusion (for example an inspection finding clean modules while a sensor reports heavy soiling).

gates.label: Recoverable energy estimated from measured soiling
gates.requirement: Cleaning effectiveness and benefit horizon were supplied, and the estimate rests on the credible soiling measurement.

gates.label: Economic inputs complete and decision-grade
gates.requirement: Every cost item and the value of energy were supplied, and the value of energy is a selling price, an avoided purchase cost or an internal valuation - not a consumer-tariff stand-in.

gates.label: Cleaning profitable in the conservative case
gates.requirement: The net benefit is positive with the low recoverable-energy estimate and the high cost estimate.

principle: A production gap is an observation, not a diagnosis. CLEAN_NOW requires every gate; anything less is INVESTIGATE or MONITOR.

rules.applies_when: Production data are not reliable measured data, or the baseline is not documented.
rules.rationale: Without trustworthy production and a known reference there is no gap to reason about.

rules.applies_when: A technical issue is open in the assessment window.
rules.rationale: Its losses cannot be separated from soiling, and cleaning would not recover them.

rules.applies_when: The evidence contains a critical contradiction.
rules.rationale: A decision resting on one of two contradicting sources would be arbitrary.

rules.applies_when: Every one of the ten gates is passed.
rules.rationale: Measured under-performance, explained by measured soiling, with nothing else open, and a cleaning that pays even in the conservative case.

rules.applies_when: The deviation is significant, a material part of it is unexplained, and soiling is not credibly measured and consistent with it.
rules.rationale: A production gap alone does not prove soiling.

rules.applies_when: Soiling is credibly measured and matches the deviation, but the recoverable energy or the economic inputs are not decision-grade.
rules.rationale: It cannot yet be shown that cleaning pays.

rules.applies_when: None of the above: no significant deviation, a deviation explained by something cleaning does not change, or a cleaning that would not pay.
rules.rationale: Nothing to act on now; the analysis is repeated after the review interval.

rules.applies_when: A CLEAN_NOW result is re-checked independently against the gates and the provenance of its decisive evidence, and the check fails.
rules.rationale: Defence in depth: a programming error in the rules must not be able to issue a cleaning order.

thresholds.description: Coverage factor k applied to standard uncertainties (2 corresponds to about 95 %).
thresholds.name: coverage_factor

thresholds.description: Minimum share of daylight intervals with both expected and actual data.
thresholds.name: min_data_completeness

thresholds.description: Length of the most recent window describing the current state of the plant [days].
thresholds.name: assessment_window_days

thresholds.description: A measured soiling loss below this is not treated as credible evidence [%].
thresholds.name: soiling_credibility_floor_pct

thresholds.description: Maximum age of a spot soiling measurement relative to the period end [days].
thresholds.name: soiling_measurement_max_age_days

thresholds.description: Allowed disagreement between the measured soiling loss and the gap it should explain [% points].
thresholds.name: consistency_tolerance_pct

thresholds.description: Daily rainfall assumed to clean the array [mm] (Kimber et al. 2006 use about 6 mm).
thresholds.name: rain_cleaning_threshold_mm

thresholds.description: Minimum dry spell before a downward trend is read as possible soiling [days].
thresholds.name: min_dry_days_for_trend

thresholds.description: Availability below this in the assessment window counts as an open equipment issue.
thresholds.name: availability_alert_fraction

thresholds.description: A device yielding less than this share of the fleet median is under-performing.
thresholds.name: device_underperformance_ratio

thresholds.description: Actual energy below this share of expected energy, in daylight, marks an outage interval.
thresholds.name: outage_actual_fraction

thresholds.description: Excess loss near sunrise or sunset over midday that suggests shading [% points].
thresholds.name: shading_edge_excess_pct

thresholds.description: A level shift of the performance index larger than this is an abrupt change [% points].
thresholds.name: step_change_min_drop_pct

thresholds.description: A quantified effect smaller than this share of expected energy is immaterial [%].
thresholds.name: factor_materiality_pct
